build_mmap_indexed_dataset: build a MMapIndexedDataset from tensors using MMapIndexedDatasetBuilder to create memory-mapped indexed dataset files
build_indexed_dataset: build an IndexedDataset from tensors using IndexedDatasetBuilder to create TorchNet-style indexed dataset files
create_dataset_from_path: create a dataset instance from a path using make_dataset with the desired implementation strategy
infer_dataset_impl: infer the dataset implementation type from an existing dataset path by reading the index file magic bytes
best_fitting_int_dtype: determine the best fitting numpy integer dtype for a given maximum integer value to optimize storage
